Open-source alternative to: Notion
Visit Official Website ↗ GitHub Repository ★ 77,800

About AppFlowy

AppFlowy is the leading open-source alternative to Notion. Built with Rust and Flutter, it offers complete data control, local-first storage, native desktop apps, and customizable AI extensions.

Core Functionalities:

✓ 100% Data privacy & offline local-first mode
✓ Kanban boards, tables, calendars, and nested pages
✓ Self-hosted sync server support via Docker
✓ Native performance across Windows, macOS, and Linux

Quick Self-Host Command:

# Deploy AppFlowy with Docker
docker run -d --name appflowy -p 8080:80 appflowy/latest
